Introduction

Athena is a South Korean-Swedish singer and composer under ATTRAKT. Best known for being a member of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY, she was revealed as a member on August 11, 2024, and debuted with the group on August 30, 2024, with the pre-release single "Starry Night".
